title: No structural-survey/shape-count analysis reduction: skeleton surveys and arch ratchets run on rg + targeted reads
missing_primitive: analysis.matchShape / analysis.structuralSurvey: repo-bounded count + file list + capped exemplars for a structural predicate
fallback_used: Skeleton surveys run rg/grep/find + targeted file reads per detection signature; arch-ratchet calibration counts violations with an ad-hoc ArchUnit rule. analysis.references covers symbol-name reference counts only, not structural shapes; code.query is per-file tree-sitter, aggregate-capped, and returns heap-heavy spans.
notes: Tier 1 per the toolbox gap map (§5). Fits the facts-vs-analysis two-tier philosophy exactly: a structural question answered as a Rust-side reduction. Entry activity for the entire campaign portfolio (dozens of concerns), so leverage is breadth, not depth on one concern.
